entryNotice.title: Entry point
entryNotice.body: This group's screens and Core-backed controls ship in a later package. No Core contract is wired in this milestone, so nothing beyond this entry is shown.
entryNotice.localOnlyBody: The local-preference controls on this page work now; the remaining screens for this group ship in a later package.

common.draftPreservedSafely: Your unsaved input and local draft have been preserved safely.

validationFailed.title: Validation failed
validationFailed.explanation: One or more submitted fields did not meet the Core validation schema. Review the highlighted inputs and try again.

configConflict.title: Configuration conflict
configConflict.explanation: The configuration changed since you loaded it. Refresh the authoritative revision before applying your edits.

authzDenied.title: Permission denied
authzDenied.explanation: Your current Core session does not have permission for this action, or your session needs re-authentication.

notFound.title: Resource not found
notFound.explanation: The requested item no longer exists or is outside your active Core workspace scope.

conflictState.title: State conflict detected
conflictState.explanation: This record moved to a newer revision on the Core. Compare the latest authoritative state before retrying.

conflictIdempotencyKey.title: Duplicate operation key
conflictIdempotencyKey.explanation: The Core already recorded a different request with this idempotency key. Re-read authoritative state to verify whether your action succeeded.

singleInstanceConflict.title: Another Core instance is active
singleInstanceConflict.explanation: Another Karyora Core process currently owns this workspace lock. Switch to the running Core connection instead of starting a conflicting instance.

storageUnavailable.title: Storage temporarily unavailable
storageUnavailable.explanation: The Core could not reach its local or remote storage backend. Check storage availability and retry.

migrationFailed.title: Data migration failed
migrationFailed.explanation: The Core halted a schema or data migration safely before committing partial changes. Inspect diagnostics before retrying.

stateCorrupt.title: Stored state integrity error
stateCorrupt.explanation: The Core detected an integrity check failure on persisted state and stopped to protect your data. Restore from a verified backup or open diagnostics.

recoveryRequired.title: Recovery check required
recoveryRequired.explanation: The previous operation did not finish cleanly. Re-read authoritative Core state to confirm the current status before continuing.

rateLimited.title: Rate limit reached
rateLimited.explanation: Too many requests were sent in a short window. Wait briefly and retry explicitly.

internal.title: Internal Core error
internal.explanation: The Core reported an unexpected internal failure. Your local draft was not discarded; copy the correlation ID if you export diagnostics.

unknownCode.title: Core rejected the request
unknownCode.explanation: The Core returned an unrecognized machine error code. No raw backend text is rendered; verify Core health or export redacted diagnostics.

unknownOutcomeS4.title: Operation outcome unknown
unknownOutcomeS4.explanation: The connection dropped before the Core confirmed whether this mutation succeeded. Do not assume failure or success—re-read authoritative Core state first.
